entities.summary: Tymofiy Bohdanovych Khmelnytsky or Tymish Bohdanovych Khmelnytsky, also known as Tymosh Khmelnychenko was a Zaporozhian Cossack military commander. He was the eldest son of the Ukrainian Cossack Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky.
